build_transformer_encoder: build a TransformerEncoder with language-specific embeddings and configurable layer sharing for multilingual NMT
build_transformer_decoder: build a TransformerDecoder with optional encoder-decoder embedding sharing and beam search generation
run_transformer_encoder_forward: run the TransformerEncoder forward pass to encode source tokens into a LatentState with encoder output and padding mask
generate_translation: generate translated sentences from encoded latent states using greedy sampling or beam search decoding
create_transformer_encoder_layer: create a TransformerEncoderLayer with multi-head self-attention, feed-forward network, and residual connections
